To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there is no good quality evidence to suggest that information transfer between hospitals and community based practitioners is a major cause of adverse outcomes; (2) the evidence that information technology can assist in discharge communications is weak, and (3) information technology has not been used to improve the quality of communication of discharge information
